en.title: Prototype 2 (port ) [NRO][RUS/ENG]
en.description: A deadly virus that has broken free has turned the metropolis into the threshold of hell. Divided into security zones, the city has become a huge trap. Some of the streets are controlled by the military, who destroy any manifestation of the infection. The remaining areas have turned into a “red zone” - the abode of mutants who mercilessly devour their victims. Somewhere out there, among the destroyed buildings, is hiding Alex Mercer, the main culprit in the spread of the virus. And now former sergeant James Heller is also heading there, eager to avenge his family who died in the first days of the cataclysm. Welcome to New York Zero. Hunting season is open. The continuation of the cruel and bloody bestseller from the studio Radical Entertainment will continue the story of the transformation of a person into an absolute weapon. Wreak havoc and destruction on the city streets using the abilities the virus gives you. Transform the hero's body by absorbing numerous enemies. Use limitless travel options to explore the ruins of New York Zero for new experiences. Fight. Kill. Change. Sacrifice your humanity for a single goal - to destroy... Alex... Mercer!

en.title: Harvest Moon Echoes of Teradea [NSZ][ENG]
en.description: Otpravlyaytes v nezabyvaemoe puteshestvie po volshebnomu miru Teradei, gde spokoynaya fermerskaya zhizn vstrechaetsya s zakhvatyvayushchimi priklyucheniyami! Zagadochnyy tuman rasprostranyaetsya iz Lesa Ekha, dikie zveri brodyat v nochnoy tme, a strannye bedstviya ugrozhayut derevnyam po vsey zemle.

en.title: Need For Speed Underground (khoumbryu NFS:U) [NRO][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
en.description:
The action takes place in a fictional city at night called Olympic City. In the story, the main character gains respect by participating in street racing and tries to surpass the best racer in the city, Eddie. There are several different types of races in the game, each of which has its own characteristics. Winning competitions earns you style points and cash, as well as unlocks new cars and a variety of tuning and styling parts.
The game was based on street racing, which became popular thanks to the movie "Fast and Furious". The developers wanted to revive the Need for Speed ​​series due to its declining sales levels. The new part was a reboot of the franchise. The gaming press greeted Need for Speed: Underground positively. Reviewers praised the gameplay, graphics, and sound; Underground became a commercial success - in total, more than 15 million copies of the game were sold. Other Need For Speed ​​games.

en.title: Need For Speed Carbon (khoumbryu NFS:C) [NRO][RUS]
en.description:
The action takes place in the city of Palmont, in which the player is given freedom of movement in the open world. The main character must win races in city districts and assemble a team to solve the story of the stolen bag of money, which happened before the story of the last game. The action moves again to the night. The main innovations in Need for Speed: Carbon are the ability to assemble a team of racers and capture areas. The Carbon also features the Autosculpt tuning system for the first time. Unlike the previous part of the game, the police in Carbon are less active and the main emphasis is on racing and car tuning.
The entire game takes place in a city called Palmont, which features both large city streets and industrial areas, as well as a canyon that surrounds the entire city. Around the city are the West, East and Coal Canyons, a drifting circuit, and the small suburb of San Juan. In free driving mode you can only drive in the main areas of the city, and in the canyons, drifting circuit, and San Juan - only in races, but by hacking you can get there during free driving. The city itself is divided into four main districts, which in turn are divided into quarters:

en.title: NetherSX2 (byvsh. AetherSX2) plyus ARMSX2 NX PS2: emulyatory Sony PlayStation 2 PCSX2 dlya HOS + Deus Ex the Conspiracy [NRO][ENG]
en.description:
PlayStation 2 (yap. プレイステーション2 Pureysute:syon Tsu:, ofitsialno PS2) — vtoraya igrovaya pristavka, vypushchennaya kompaniey Sony, naslednitsa PlayStation 1 i predshestvennitsa PlayStation 3. O nachale razrabotki bylo obyavleno v marte 1999 goda, prodazhi v Yaponii nachalas 4 marta 2000-go.
Eta domashnyaya igrovaya pristavka stala naibolee bystro prodavaemoy i samoy populyarnoy igrovoy konsolyu v istorii, na tretiy kvartal 2011 goda v mire prodano pochti 155 millionov ekzemplyarov PS2. Ottsom PlayStation nazyvayut Kena Kutaragi, kotoryy stoyal vo glave gruppy, zanyatoy razrabotkoy i vypuskom na rynok snachala PlayStation v 1994 godu, a zatem PlayStation 2, PlayStation Portable i PlayStation 3. PlayStation 2 poluchila ogromnoe priznanie kritikov i igrokov posle svoego vykhoda. Obzory khvalili eyo apparatnye i graficheskie vozmozhnosti. Zhurnal PC Magazine v 2001 godu nazval konsol vydayushcheysya, vysoko otseniv eyo primechatelnye komponenty, takie kak protsessor Emotion Engine i 32 MB operativnoy pamyati.
NetherSX2 — bystryy open-source emulyator Sony PlayStation 2 dlya Android, predstavlyaet soboy obnovlyaemuyu i uluchshennuyu versiyu zakrytogo AetherSX2.
ARMSX2 — open-source emulyator s polnostyu otkrytym iskhodnym kodom po litsenzii GPLv3, prednaznachennyy dlya zapuska na ARM-ustroystvakh. Proekt ispolzuet v kachestve osnovy emulyator PCSX2 dlya PK; PCSX2 ispolzuet translyatsiyu x86-to-Arm64.
Takzhe vklyucheny sleduyushchie dve PS2-igry:

en.title: Zoids Wild Blast Unleashed / Infinity Blast [NSZ][ENG (Mod.)/JAP]
en.description:
Yarostnoe mogushchesto i zverinyy instinkt zoidov v zrelishchnykh poedinkakh odin na odin na Nintendo Switch!.. Grafika v stile anime Zoids Wild i intuitivno ponyatnaya boevaya sistema v 3D, pozvolyayushchaya s legkostyu provodit neveroyatnye kombinatsii. Zoids Wild: Blast Unleashed — eto zakhvatyvayushchie srazheniya vashikh lyubimykh pilotov i ikh zoidov!
No kto takie zoidy — prosto oruzhie ili vashi partnery? Vashe masterstvo v boyu opredelit, kto vozmet verkh v konflikte mezhdu komandy «Svoboda» pod predvoditelstvom Arashi i komandy «Temnyy metall» v novoy istorii. Svodite schety v srazheniyakh dlya dvukh igrokov, ispytayte masterstvo v rezhimakh zadaniy i srazheniy i ottochite navyki v rezhime praktiki. Vybirayte geroya, vykhodite na pole bitvy i srazhaytes, chtoby probudit velichayshuyu svyaz mezhdu lyudmi i zoidami — a potom ispolzuyte skrytoe mogushchestvo «Dikogo vzryva», chtoby pobedit protivnikov.

en.title: Renai Zero Kilometer (Ren'ai 恋愛0キロメートル) [NSP][ENG]
en.description:
Vizualnaya novella s vyborami!... Kontsovka igry zavisit ot prinyatykh vami resheniy. V rezultate vremennogo «obmena» mezhdu semyami glavnyy geroy okazyvaetsya v dome svoey podrugi detstva, gde on sblizhaetsya s ocharovatelnoy devushkoy i provodit vremya za dushevnymi besedami..
V seme Yadzaki rastut chetvero bratev, kotorykh vospityvaet otets, a v seme Kinomoto — pyat sester, kotorykh vospityvaet mat. Obe semi davno mechtali o rebenke: Yadzaki khoteli doch, a Kinomoto — syna. Odnazhdy roditeli predlagayut neozhidannuyu avantyuru: «A davayte na tri mesyatsa pomenyaemsya detmi — pust kazhdyy iz nikh pozhivet v drugoy seme!» Tak vtoroy syn Yadzaki, Kyoiti, i vtoraya doch Kinomoto, Sakuya, menyayutsya mestami i nachinayut novuyu zhizn v chuzhoy seme.
Zhizneradostnye sestry Kinomoto ponachalu ne znayut, kak vesti sebya s Kyoiti — nazyvat ego «bratikom» kazhetsya im strannym, — no so vremenem oni pronikayutsya k nemu simpatiey. Sam zhe Kyoiti ponachalu teryaetsya v dome, polnom devchonok. Odnako, nesmotrya na tsaryashchiy vokrug khaos, on nachinaet oshchushchat to, chego nikogda ne znal prezhde — teplo nastoyashchey semi.
Srok v tri mesyatsa podkhodit k kontsu. Provodya vremya vmeste, Kyoiti, Sakuya i ikh semi osoznayut, naskolko dorogimi oni stali drug dlya druga. Kogda otvedennoe vremya istechet... vernutsya li oni k svoey prezhney zhizni ili vyberut chto-to novoe?..Eshchyo vizualnykh novell na Switch (renpy).

en.title: Toy Story 3 Complete edition / Disney Pixar Toy Story Retro Roundup (6 games) [NSZ][RUS,ENG/Multi19]
en.interface_lang: Russian (tolko u «Toy Story 3»), English [RUS / ENG / Multi 19]
en.voice_lang: Russian (tolko u «Toy Story 3»), English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, shvedskaya, norvezhskaya, Polish, cheshskaya, datskaya, Portuguese, finskaya
en.description:
Reopen the toy chest and saddle up as Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and Jessie in Toy Story 3 Complete Edition, a 3D adventure based on the hit 2010 animated film, Toy Story 3. The updated game features improved graphics and a few new surprises in store. Play through authentic moments from the movie in Story Mode, or drop into the wild west sandbox of Woody’s Roundup in Toy Box Mode. 

In Story Mode, swap between Woody, Buzz, and Jessie as you play through iconic scenes from the film, including the train rescue, Operation Playtime, surviving the junkyard, and more. Harness each character's unique abilities, whether you need to swing on Woody’s pull string or use Buzz’s strength to throw the other toys long distances. You can even play in two-player co-op. 

Step out of Story Mode and into the sandbox in Toy Box Mode. This fan-favorite, customizable mode drops you into the wild west of Woody’s Roundup. Like Story Mode, you play as Woody, Buzz, or Jessie, but in Toy Box Mode you can play however you want! Characters around town give you quests to complete, so you can earn gold and spend it on personalizing the town your way. Build, decorate and customize the buildings, dress up the townsfolk, and more.

Toy Story 3 Complete Edition also includes content that was previously restricted to certain versions of the game. Players can now play as the Evil Emperor Zurg in Toy Box Mode, and can access four additional Theme Packs to decorate their Toy Box. Toy Story 3 Complete Edition also features upgraded graphics, resolution, and framerate.

FEATURES

- Toy Story 3 Complete Edition brings back a fan-favorite game. 

- Relive key moments from the movie in Story Mode from Andy's room to Sunnyside Daycare.

- Swap between Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and Jessie, each of with different abilities you’ll need to complete each level. 

- Dive into the sandbox in Toy Box Mode. Take on missions for your fellow toys, dress up the townsfolk, decorate buildings, and much more. 

- Play with a friend in local, two player co-op. Available in Story Mode or Toy Box Mode. 

- All versions now include previously exclusive content, such as the ability to play as Emperor Zurg in Toy Box Mode.

en.title: Torchlight 1 (port ) [NRO][RUS/ENG]
en.description:
The action takes place in the city of Twilight, which, according to the creators, is located on an unnamed mountain, which is the source of a valuable crystalline resource associated with magic. The resource is called ember. It not only has material and scientific value, but is also a source of dangerous effects on living organisms. With prolonged contact with an amber, a person can become possessed and/or turn into a monster. Under the city there is a multi-tiered system of catacombs, mines, necropolises, and volcanic zones, which the player explores in search of equipment, weapons, money, and items related to the private orders of some of the inhabitants of Twilight.
At the same time, the creators of Torchlight were a considerable part of those developers who worked on the creation of the Diablo series of games, for example, Travis Baldry, developer of the game Fate; Max Schafer and Eric Schafer, co-developers of Diablo and Diablo 2, are also joined by the team that worked on Mythos.
All levels of the dungeons are filled with a variety of monsters, by defeating which the protagonist grows financially, and also receives experience points and fame, with the help of which he improves his skills and adds strength, dexterity, protection and magic to his characteristics. Many monsters are found only in a certain type of terrain, while other types of monsters can be found in all types of terrain. Other parts of Torchlight.

en.title: Touhou 15 Legacy of Lunatic Kingdom / 11 / 10 Mountain of Faith / 9 Phantasmagoria of Flower View / Wonderful Waking World / 8 Imperishable Night / 7 Perfect Cherry Blossom / 6 Koumakyou the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil (port y EoSD, PCB, IN, WWW, PoFV, MOF, SA, LLK) [NRO][JAP,ENG]
en.developer: Team Shanghai Alice, ZUN, Alliance Arts
en.description:
V odin iz letnikh dney zemli Gensokyo zavolakivaet strannym alym tumanom, prakticheski polnostyu blokiruyushchim solnechnyy svet. Zhritsa Reymu Khakurey schitaet svoim dolgom vyyasnit prichinu etogo pogodnogo yavleniya. Volshebnitsa Marisa Kirisame otpravlyaetsya v rassledovanie s nadezhdoy nayti interesnye magicheskie predmety.
Vybrannaya igrokom geroinya dobiraetsya do osobnyaka, raspolozhennogo na ostrove posredi ozera, i stalkivaetsya s mnogochislennoy okhranoy. Sozdatelnitsey tumana okazyvaetsya khozyayka osobnyaka, vampiressa Remiliya Skarlet, «Alaya Dyavolitsa». Tak kak vampiry ne perenosyat pryamoy solnechnyy svet, ona reshila zablokirovat ego tumanom, chtoby komfortno chuvstvovat sebya dnyom. V khode tyazhyologo srazheniya geroinya pobezhdaet Remiliyu, i v Gensokyo vozvrashchaetsya normalnaya pogoda..
V igre predstavleno dva igrabelnykh personazha (Reymu Khakurey i Marisa Kirisame), dlya kazhdogo iz kotorykh pered nachalom igry mozhno vybrat odin iz dvukh tipov ataki, razlichayushchikhsya kharakterom strelby i deystviem bomb, «kart zaklinaniy». V EoSD poyavlyaetsya vozmozhnost «avtomaticheskogo sbora bonusov»: esli personazh, obladaya polnoy energiey, podnimetsya v verkhnyuyu oblast ekrana, to vse vidimye bonusy prityanutsya k nemu. Drugoe novovvedenie — vozmozhnost primenit bombu srazu zhe posle stolknoveniya s puley protivnika, tem samym sokhranyaya personazhu zhizn.Drugie Touhou-igry tut.

en.title: Just Dance® 2022 [NSP][ENG]
en.description:
Just Dance® 2022, the ultimate dance game, is back with new environments and 40 hot new tracks from chart-topping hits like ""Don't Go Yet"" by Camila Cabello, ""Love Story (Taylor's Version)"" by Taylor Swift, ""Happier Than Ever"" by Billie Eilish, and more! 
 
• Exercise while having fun and start your own your routine with Just Dance® Unlimited Sweat mode. 
• Team up with your dance-on-demand streaming service! 
• Engage the little ones with eight kid-friendly songs and choreographies with Kids mode. 

 Just Dance Standard Edition includes a 1-month free trial of Just Dance Unlimited!

en.title: To the Moon / Finding Paradise / A Bird Story [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
en.description:
Dr. Rosalene and Dr. Watts have peculiar jobs: They give people another chance to live, all the way from the very beginning... but only in their patients' heads.

Due to the severity of the operation, the new life becomes the last thing the patients remember before drawing their last breath. Thus, the operation is only done to people on their deathbeds, to fulfill what they wish they had done with their lives, but didn’t.

This particular story follows their attempt to fulfill the dream of an elderly man, Johnny. With each step back in time, a new fragment of Johnny's past is revealed. As the two doctors piece together the puzzled events that spanned a lifetime, they seek to find out just why the frail old man chose his dying wish to be what it is.

And Johnny's last wish is, of course... to go to the moon.

KEY FEATURES
• A unique & non-combat story-driven experience
• Innovative mix between adventure game elements and classic RPG aesthetics
• Acclaimed original soundtrack that closely ties to the story
• An espresso execution with zero filler and no time drains

en.title: Vault of Power [NSZ][ENG]
en.description: Osvoyte moshchnye navyki, strategicheski razmeshchayte svoikh yunitov i pokoryayte slozhnye podzemelya.

en.title: Cubic Cosmos [NSP][ENG]
en.description:
Dinamichnaya kartochnaya igra!
Soberite neuderzhimuyu armiyu fishek, svyazyvayte moshchnye kombo i naslazhdaytes beskonechnymi vozmozhnostyami!..

en.title: Croc's World 1-5 / Run [NSZ][ENG,RUS]
en.description:
«Mir krokodilchika Kroki» — eto seriya prostykh arkadnykh platformerov dlya samykh malenkikh igrokov, sozdannykh s nastoyashchim nemetskim kachestvom!
300+ neveroyatnykh urovney + akkuratnaya HD-grafika + 15 raznykh biomov + mnozhestvo vragov: naydite shlem, chtoby razbivat kamennye bloki, otyshchite meshok s kamnyami, chtoby brosatsya imi, a esli soberyote 100 brilliantov, to poluchite dopolnitelnye zhizni!
Vklyucheny 6 igr:

en.title: Lydia [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
en.description:
• "One of the most emotionally impactful games..." Nintendo Life
• "This child's tale deals skillfully with adult issues." The Washington Post

Based on the developers' real experience, this award-winning story makes no compromise. 

Grow up with Lydia and try to understand the feelings, behaviours and events that moulded critical moments of her life. How may a resenting and alcoholic household affect a little girl full of imagination? How may she perceive the twisted and manipulative family dynamics? Confront the monster with your own sensitivity.

This hand-drawn game can be completed in around one hour. The emotional music was composed by renowned film composer Juhana Lehtiniemi.

The issues reflected in this story unfortunately happen in real people’s daily life. You can provide some help by donating to the "Fragile Childhood" foundation via the DLC #LydiaDonation. 

• "Lydia is an important game, not just because it broaches an important subject matter, but for how it uses its art direction, music, and storytelling to highlight the issues it's bringing to our attention." GodisaGeek
• "It successfully tells a haunting story about abuse and heartbreak without necessarily shoving it down your throat, and that’s really hard to do." Nintendo Life
• "Lydia is a small game, but it sends a bigger message..." Pure Nintendo

DEVELOPED BY Platonic Partnership
“Our Finnish studio is focusing on narrative-driven games that motivate change. Lydia is someone who wishes for a happy childhood but can never have it. People with similar experiences will see this, so hopefully the game is really genuine and respectful.” – Henri Tervapuro, graphic novel artist and co-author of this self-inspired story.

PUBLISHED BY Nakana.io 
“We gather games that share a strong experience to remember. We try to grow real changes from the seeds of their message, like with the #LydiaDonation DLC.” – Mikaël Bourget, founder of the publishing label.

en.title: Zenonia [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
en.description:
The legendary ZENONIA from the 2000s is back. The journey that began on the screens continues. Get back to your roots and experience the joy of growing your hero once again! ZENONIA returns to Switch to give you a taste of true adventure again.
The cult Action-RPG, which defined the entire genre, returns in its original form. This journey will be a valuable experience both for those who yearn to relive their favorite moments, and for those who are just discovering the origins of the cult game. The quintessential classic RPG: who will you be? Choose your calling and master one of three canonical classes:

en.title: Silver Pines [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
en.description: Private investigator Red Walker finds himself in Silver Pines—a half-abandoned, half-forgotten place—to find missing musician Eddie Velvet. As the investigation unfolds, dark secrets are revealed, and Walker soon finds himself in a strange and nightmarish situation that he cannot control.

en.title: Constance [NSP][RUS/Multi16]
en.description:
Become Paint
Utilize paint-based mechanics to experience a constant state of flow—dive into the ground and walls, slice through the air and enemies!

Wield Your Brush
Become stronger by unlocking new techniques with your brush that aid you in defeating threatening foes, overcoming platform challenges, solving complex puzzles, and advancing your progress.

Discover Yourself
Explore Constance's non-linear interconnected world and discover countless secrets, abilities, upgrades, characters, side quests, and inspiring moments. 

Strive for Balance
Using your brush techniques will corrupt your Paint. If you become fully corrupted, negative effects await you, so be wary!

Get Inspired
Use inspirations that you find on your travels to sketch in your journal. Your sketches enhance and customize Constance's capabilities. By gathering materials, you can upgrade your sketches into even stronger artworks.

Choice in Death
Upon death, choose how to continue your journey. Do you want to persevere through the challenge, at a price? Or do you return to a safe point and explore other unbeaten paths?

Rich Imagined World
The inner world is strongly connected to Constance's mental health journey, with each colorful biome and its unique set of enemies and characters representing different aspects of her psyche and personal history. 

Interactive Backstory
Experience playable flashbacks about personal struggle, creativity, work-life-balance, and inner purpose. Step into Constance's socks to uncover her past!

en.title: Creepy Tale 1 / 2 / 3 Ingrid Penance / 4 Some Other Place / 5 Snow Child [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
en.description:
Bespechnyy pokhod za gribami vmeste s bratom oborachivaetsya uzhasom i zatyagivaet geroya v cheredu zhutkikh sobytiy. Brat pokhishchen, a vy ostaetes odin na odin so zloveshchim lesom, napolnennym opasnostyami i strannymi sushchestvami. Reshayte golovolomki, kotorye vstrechayutsya u vas na puti, ne dayte sebya poymat i spasite brata iz lap nechistoy sily!
Uznayte temnuyu istoriyu, kotoraya postigla nekogda spokoynyy i mirolyubivyy les, prevrativ ego v zhutkoe mesto, napolnennoe zlom. Vozmozhno, imenno vy smozhete razgadat vse tayny i spasti eshche poka mirnykh zhiteley lesa?

en.title: Tales of Eternia Remastered [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
en.developer: Tose Co.Ltd. 株式会社トーセ, Wolfteam
en.description:
Experience Tales of Eternia, remastered for the first time ever.

• An Epic Journey with Two Worlds at Stake
Journey to Eternia, a world split into two isolated realms, Inferia and Celestia.
In the remote Inferian village of Rasheans, Reid Hershel and his childhood friend Farah Oersted meet a mysterious girl named Meredy. During their journey to discover Meredy's origins, the group discovers that a collision called the "Great Fall" threatens both Inferia and Celesita.
Harnessing the power of elemental spirits known as the Greater Craymels, Reid and his companions embark on an epic journey to save the two realms from catastrophe.

• Exhilarating Battle Action with Speed and Freedom
Featuring the Aggressive Linear Motion Battle System (A-LMBS), which enables diverse Arte usage, continued combos, and coordination with each unique party member.
Experience thrilling combat as you outmaneuver enemies and defeat them one after another with fast-paced, dynamic 2D battle action.

• The Same Moving Experience, Now Easier to Play
Gameplay is better than ever with the quality-of-life features that have been added, including destination markers, the ability to disable enemy encounters, and high-speed mode during auto-battle.
Additionally, graphics and SFX can be toggled between modes, allowing you to experience the nostalgic atmosphere of the original game.

en.title: NOVA 3 Near Orbit Vanguard Alliance (port ) [NRO][RUS/Multi10]
en.description:
A sci-fi first-person shooter with action-adventure elements, developed by Gameloft Bucharest and published by Gameloft. The game became the third part of the N.O.V.A series. and was released on the App Store and Google Play on May 10, 2012 for devices based on iOS, BlackBerry 10 and Android; later, in 2013, there were releases for the BlackBerry PlayBook and Windows Phone 8. Unlike previous parts, when creating N.O.V.A. 3, the developers focused heavily on games such as Killzone, Call of Duty and Crysis 2, while the early games in the series were mainly influenced by the Halo franchise.
The single campaign consists of 10 levels for single player play, in which the main character is once again Cal Wardin, the former captain of the Near Orbit Vanguard Alliance unit.
On his way to the abandoned Earth, Cal Wardin receives a distress call from his AI assistant, Elena. His ship crashes among the ruins of San Francisco; Cal joins the Echo-1 squad to restore communication and fight their way to the NOVA base. There he learns that NOVA has stolen the Judges' artifact in the hope that it will help make Earth habitable again.

en.title: Silent Hill 2 EE (port ) [NRO][RUS]
en.description:
Deystvie proiskhodit vo vselennoy, v kotoroy povsednevnaya deystvitelnost peresekaetsya s pugayushchim alternativnym mirom, otrazhayushchim vnutrennee sostoyanie geroya. Glavnym geroem yavlyaetsya Dzheyms Sanderlend, kotoryy poluchil pismo ot svoey suprugi Meri, umershey za nekotoroe vremya do nachala osnovnykh sobytiy igry. V pisme ona prosit ego priekhat v kurortnyy gorodok Saylent Khill…
Igra poluchila shirokoe priznanie so storony kritikov: desyat razlichnykh izdaniy postavili igre naivysshiy ball, bolshinstvo obozrevateley vysoko otsenili atmosfernost i glubinu syuzheta, stroyashchegosya vokrug lyubvi, nenavisti, smerti, prestupleniya i nakazaniya, bezumiya, a takzhe tabuirovannykh tem seksualnogo nasiliya i intsesta. Muzykalnoe soprovozhdenie, po mneniyu nekotorykh kritikov, yavlyalos odnim iz luchshikh v istorii igrovoy industrii. Silent Hill 2 vkhodit v spiski luchshikh igr vsekh vremyon, a takzhe zanimaet vysokie pozitsii v chartakh luchshikh khorrorov igrovoy industrii: spustya mesyats posle starta prodazh bylo prodano svyshe odnogo milliona ekzemplyarov igry.
Silent Hill tut.

en.title: Anton Blast (AntonBlast the Dynamite) [NSZ][ENG]
en.description:
ANTONBLAST is a fast-paced explosive action platformer that's all about destruction. Play as the enraged Dynamite Anton (or his cranked-out coworker Annie) and use your Mighty F’n Hammer to demolish bizarre worlds, tussle with screen-filling bosses, and steal your Spirits back from Satan!

That's right: Satan himself has stolen Anton's prized Spirit collection, and he'll stop at nothing to get it back. Thankfully, the local disgraced casino owner, Brulo, has his own beef with Satan, and he's willing to put aside his differences with Anton to make that devil pay.

Your mission in every level is simple: SET Brulo's Detonators, FIND Anton's Spirit, and ESCAPE before Happy Hour ends!

en.title: Astroneer + DLC Megatech, Glitchwalkers [NSP][RUS/Multi11]
en.description:
Explore and Reshape Distant Worlds! Astroneer is set during the 25th century Intergalactic Age of Discovery, where Astroneers explore the frontiers of outer space, risking their lives in harsh environments to unearth rare discoveries and unlock the mysteries of the universe.

On this adventure, players can work together to build custom bases above or below ground, create vehicles to explore a vast solar system, and use terrain to create anything they can imagine. A player’s creativity and ingenuity are the key to seeking out and thriving while on exciting planetary adventures! In Astroneer you can:

•Reshape the ground under your feet as though it were made of clay.
•Survive on and explore carefully crafted planets that can be entirely deformed and traversed.
•Snap together components and objects to build bases and vehicles.
•Play with friends in 4 player online drop-in/drop-out co-op.
•Discover and uncover the mysteries of the solar system

•••Deform & shape everything around you•••
In Astroneer, players use their deform tool to dig, collect, shape and build anything they wish. Use this ability to dig to the center of the planet, build a ramp into the sky, or make megaliths just by using terrain!

en.title: Toem: A Photo Adventure 1-2 [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
en.description:
Embark on an exciting journey and keep your camera ready to uncover the mysteries of TOEM in this hand-drawn adventure game.
Chat with quirky characters, help solve their problems with photos, and admire the beautiful scenery!

en.title: Mini Metro / Mini Motorways [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
en.description:
Have you ever been stuck in traffic and wished you could do something to fix it? In Mini Motorways, the city’s traffic problems are in your hands. 

From the makers of Mini Metro, Mini Motorways is a game about drawing the roads that drive a growing city. Build a road network, one road at a time, to create a bustling metropolis. Redesign your city to keep the traffic flowing, and carefully manage upgrades to meet the changing demands. How long can you keep the cities of the world moving?

Features:

• Draw roads in dynamic cities that grow and change - every game is unique!
• Explore stunning maps inspired by cities all around the world.
• Choose from a variety of upgrades to meet the demands of your ever-expanding road network: highways, roundabouts, and more!
• Stress-free Endless Mode offers you a relaxing gameplay experience, plus you can continue building your city after Game Over.
• Tackle our Expert Mode, which features twists such as permanent roads and limited upgrades for the ultimate challenge.
• Select different colour palettes on every map including colourblind and night modes.
• Relax to a responsive soundtrack from Disasterpeace that grows along with your city.
• Unlock new maps as you achieve mastery. 
• Compete against other players in Daily and Weekly Challenges.

en.title: Magical Craft: My Enchanted Dress Shop [NSZ][ENG]
en.publisher: Imagineer Co., Ltd.イマジニア株式会社
en.description:
A cute game about dresses for the most beautiful, smart and kind princesses!..
Blue sky, south wind and lots of cats: here, in an old village, surrounded by greenery and surrounded by picturesque streets, your new life begins. The action takes place in a quiet village called Fläne.
Local residents master applied magic, which makes everyday life easier and more convenient. One of these arts is the “magic of sewing”. Inspired by the example of her grandmother, whose wonderful dresses delighted everyone around her, the main character Lilia dreams of following in her footsteps. One day, she discovers her grandmother's gift for the magic of sewing and plans her own atelier, taking the first step towards becoming the greatest dressmaker of a generation. Your journey to mastery of cutting and sewing is just beginning!..
Gaming critics praised the variety of clothing models, as well as the ability to combine fabrics, patterns and decorative elements. They also enjoyed seeing the villagers wearing outfits created by the player. Four reviewers from the Japanese magazine Famitsu rated Magical Craft: My Enchanted Dress Shop 7, 8, 8 and 7 out of 10.

en.title: Prey 2006 (khoumbryu openPrey) [NRO][ENG,RUS (Voice Mod.)]
en.description:
Our story is about Domasi Tavodi (Cherokee, aka Tommy) of the Cherokee Indian Nation - a garage mechanic and former US Army soldier living on an Indian reservation in Oklahoma.
At the beginning of the game, Tommy is talking to his friend Jen at a bar. After a short fight involving the main character, something strange begins to happen: the bar suddenly shakes, and an emergency warning about an emergency sounds on TV. Then green lights light up in the sky, lifting up cars, buildings, and then Tommy himself. When he wakes up, he sees himself tied next to Jen and his grandfather Enisi inside a giant spaceship. After being delivered to the ship, the trio, along with many other prisoners, were taken through the space of the ship. There is an explosion caused by a stranger, and Tommy manages to get out of his bonds.
The project was first announced in 1995 and was developed simultaneously with Duke Nukem Forever. Tom Hall and John Romero, who worked at id Software, took part in the development. The original idea of ​​alien abduction was retained, according to Paul Schuitem's idea, they decided to add a large organic spaceship to the game, on which several races live (three of which are known as “Trokara”, and the fourth is “Guardians”), and the main character Talon Brave from the indigenous population of America. The game uses a slightly modified Doom 3 graphics engine. In October 2006, 3D Realms announced that the game had sold a million copies worldwide due to its commercial success.

en.title: Need For Speed Underground 2 (khoumbryu NFS:U2) [NRO][RUS/ENG]
en.description:
The game takes place in the fictional city of Bayview - it has similarities to Los Angeles and Las Vegas. Like Olympic City, the city of Need for Speed: Underground, there is no police force in Bayview, and the action always takes place at night. Cars drive along the city streets, and there is also a dynamic change in weather conditions - when it rains, which can start and stop at any moment, driving becomes more difficult. For orientation in the city there is a map and a GPS system.
Bayview is made up of five districts: Downtown, Old Town, Northern Highlands, East Port and West Port. They have significant differences, for example, the Downtown area is dominated by wide streets and skyscrapers, while the Northern Highlands are dominated by winding roads and canyons. Each subsequent area opens when the player completes the current stage. Most areas are connected by a network of expressways, which are highlighted in white on the map. In addition, some streets are only available in the Drag Racing type, and some areas are only available in the Street X, Drifting, Drag Racing and Pro League types.
The gameplay in Need for Speed: Underground 2 follows the main aspects of its predecessor: the player will compete in street races, earning money and gaining respect among other racers. In the sequel, the possibilities of car tuning have been significantly improved, which plays an important role in the passage. In addition, the game has new innovations such as free ride mode and jeeps. In career mode there is a plot in which the main character participates in races on the streets of the city of Bayview and tries to defeat a serious opponent - Caleb. Other Need For Speed ​​games.

en.title: Castlevania Belmont's Curse [NSP][RUS/Multi11]
en.description:
Medieval Paris, Where the Tolling Bells Herald the End
1499. Paris is engulfed in flames as monstrous creatures suddenly emerge from the shadows.
Trevor Belmont, the hero who defeated Dracula, ventures into the burning streets with his daughter, Rose Belmont. Armed with the legendary holy whip, the Vampire Killer, they hunt down the beasts bleeding from the looming castle.

Rose is soon swept up in the dark conspiracy that lurks beneath. Will she succeed in saving Paris from devastation?

Satisfying Whip Action
Castlevania's iconic whip action is more satisfying than ever!
Crack your whip to move around freely like a trapeze artist!
Master the whip mechanics and be creative to pounce on your prey like a wolf in fast-paced combat!

Diverse Bosses and the Arcana System
Face-off against legendary bosses including Death, Medusa and Carmilla in addition to enigmatic new bosses such as Joan of Arc.
Once defeated, bosses are sealed into Rose's tarot cards, turning them into Arcana - use their skills to cast spells and obtain unique special actions

Customize Your Battle Style with Weapons and Relics
Customize Rose’s battle style by using a variety of equipment, including weapons spanning seven distinct categories and Relics that trigger powerful effects through both offense and defense.
Combine equipment you discover through exploration to create your own playstyle!

Iconic Castlevania Atmosphere, Reimagined in New Stages
From iconic Gothic aesthetics to vivid, refined visuals, the game presents a fresh take on the world of Castlevania.
Explore maps filled with both new features and familiar elements inspired by classic Castlevania titles.

en.title: Azure Striker Gunvolt 1-2-3 Trilogy Enhanced / Gunvolt Chronicles Luminous Avenger iX 1+2 Dual Collection [NSP][ENG]
en.description:
Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX 1+2 Dual Collection brings together and updates the apeX of 2D action for new and old players alike.
The Dual Collection includes both Luminous Avenger iX 1 and 2, with all all DLC included, as well as balance adjustments.
It also features a new mode, Endless Battle.

●Revised balance "Director's Cut"
Luminous Avenger iX's Darkness Trigger "berserk" mode has been powered up.
Luminous Avenger iX 2 receives a new "Spike Smash" system, powering up Copen's main weapon, the Razor Wheel.
A number of other adjustments also improve gameplay balance.

●All DLC included
Every item is built in, including content that was previously limited availability.

●New "Endless Battle" mode
Luminous Avenger iX and Luminous Avenger iX 2 each receive a special mode, "Endless Battle". Configure the settings to your liking before facing off against an endless onslaught of random bosses.
How many will you be able to defeat? Take on the apeX challenge!

●Two sci-fi action stories filled with character
Copen is a hard-boiled fighter in a grim future distopia.
Can he save the powerless people he meets? And can they save him?

[Voice Cast]

Kohaku: Yumiri Hanamori (Japanese)
            Kira Buckland (English, iX 2)
Blade: Yui Ishikawa (Japanese)
Null: Sumire Morohoshi (Japanese) 
       Natalie Rose Hoover (English)

en.title: Lost Twins 2 [NSZ][Multi]
en.description:
Rearrange the world. Reunite the twins. Rediscover wonder.
Abi and Ben are lost but not alone. In Lost Twins 2, you'll shift entire pieces of the world to guide them through a beautifully handcrafted puzzle adventure full of cozy charm and clever surprises.

How it plays:
- Slide and swap tiles to reshape levels
- Solve puzzles using switches, platforms, water gates, and more
- Explore magical environments like enchanted forests and toy castles
- Play solo or team up in delightful local co-op
- Discover secrets, collectibles, and heartwarming surprises

With no enemies, no time limits, and no stress, Lost Twins 2 is a peaceful puzzle journey perfect for players of all ages.

Key Features:
Inventive Puzzle Mechanics – Slide, swap, and shift tiles to unlock new paths and reveal clever solutions

Solo or Co-Op Play – Play alone or team up with a friend in couch co-op mode

Whimsical World – Gorgeous visuals bring every corner of the world to life

Atmospheric Soundtrack – Original music that adapts to your journey’s emotional beats

Secrets & Collectibles – Find hidden paths, unlock concept art, and gather charming curios

No Two Puzzles Alike – Every level introduces fresh ideas with zero filler

Stress-Free Play – No deaths, timers, or enemies just pure puzzling joy

en.title: No Man's Sky – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition [NSP][RUS/Multi11]
en.description:
Inspired by the adventure and imagination that we love from classic science-fiction, No Man's Sky presents you with a galaxy to explore, filled with unique planets and lifeforms, and constant danger and action.

In No Man's Sky, every star is the light of a distant sun, each orbited by planets filled with life, and you can go to any of them you choose. Fly smoothly from deep space to planetary surfaces, with no loading screens, and no limits. In this infinite procedurally generated universe, you'll discover places and creatures that no other players have seen before - and perhaps never will again.

Now including...
Play with all major updates since launch: Foundation, Pathfinder, Atlas Rises, NEXT, The Abyss, Visions, the 2.0 BEYOND update, Synthesis, Living Ship, Exo Mech, Desolation and the 3.0 update, ORIGINS, Next Generation, Companions, Expeditions, Prisms, Frontiers, Sentinel, Outlaws, Endurance, Waypoint (4.0),  Fractal, Interceptor, Echoes, Omega, Orbital, Worlds Part I (5.0), Worlds Part II and Relics. 

An epic voyage to the centre of a shared universe awaits, allowing you to explore, trade, fight and survive alone or with friends. 

Embark on an epic voyage
At the centre of the galaxy lies a irresistible pulse which draws you on a journey towards it to learn the true nature of the cosmos. But, facing hostile creatures and fierce pirates, you'll know that death comes at a cost, and survival will be down to the choices you make over how you upgrade your ship, your weapon and suit.

Find your own destiny
Your voyage through No Man's Sky is up to you. Will you be a fighter, preying on the weak and taking their riches, or taking out pirates for their bounties? Power is yours if you upgrade your ship for speed and weaponry.

Or a trader? Find rich resources on forgotten worlds and exploit them for the highest prices. Invest in more cargo space and you'll reap huge rewards.

Or perhaps an explorer? Go beyond the known frontier and discover places and things that no one has ever seen before. Upgrade your engines to jump ever farther, and strengthen your suit for survival in toxic environments that would kill the unwary.

Share your journey
The galaxy is a living, breathing place. Trade convoys travel between stars, factions vie for territory, pirates hunt the unwary, and the police are ever watching. Every other player lives in the same galaxy, and you can choose to share your discoveries with them on a map that spans known space. Perhaps you will see the results of their actions as well as your own...

es.title: Lost Odyssey (port ) [NRO][ENG]
es.description:
La energía mágica siempre ha estado contenida en los seres vivos, pero su poder ha aumentado enormemente 30 años antes de los acontecimientos del juego. Esto influyó mucho en la sociedad mediante la creación del dispositivo "Magic Engine", que hizo posible utilizar el poder mágico para iluminación, automóviles, comunicaciones, robots y otros fines. Si antes sólo unos pocos podían utilizar la magia, ahora muchos han tenido esta oportunidad.
Este progreso también creó el deseo entre las dos naciones, el Reino de Gohtz y la República de Uhra, de una sociedad monárquica recientemente reformada; desarrollar armas de destrucción masiva nuevas y más poderosas. Los Uhra construyen el Gran Bastón, un gigantesco motor mágico, mientras que los altamente industrializados Gohtza estudian activamente la magia dentro de ellos mismos. La tercera nación, los Estados del Océano Libre de Numara, permanecen aisladas y neutrales, pero caen en el caos debido a los intentos de golpe de Estado. Uhra lucha contra los Khents, una nación de hombres bestia, y ellos envían sus fuerzas a las montañas Wal para la batalla final, ¡donde comienza el juego!...
Odisea perdida, japonesa. Rosuto odessey ロストオデッセイ, o Lost Odyssey, es un juego de rol japonés publicado por Microsoft Game Studios exclusivamente para Xbox 360. Lost Odyssey fue creado por Hironobu Sakaguchi, creador de la famosa serie Final Fantasy. Este es el tercer proyecto de Sakaguchi fuera de Square Enix, después de ASH: Archaic Sealed Heat y Blue Dragon. El jugador controla a un personaje llamado Kaim, un hombre que ha vivido durante mil años sin recordar su pasado, y comienza en un mundo en el que se acerca una mágica "revolución industrial": Kaim lucha por recuperar su memoria y el dolor que ésta conlleva. Famitsu le dio al juego una puntuación de 36/40, y los cuatro críticos le dieron nueve.
Vídeo tráiler.

es.title: Fear and Hunger (port ) [NRO][RUS/ENG]
es.interface_lang: Ruso (lyubitelskiy de Rotten Cabbage Team), Inglés [RUS / ENG]
es.description:
"Nuestras palabras son como gotas de sangre que fluyen. Sólo el dolor revela plenamente a las personas". ~©
El juego está destinado exclusivamente a un público adulto con una psique estable: la crueldad extrema y la crueldad son comunes en todas las mazmorras, hay una demostración del uso de drogas y se plantean temas difíciles, desde la autotortura hasta la violencia sexual. Todos ellos son una parte integral de la creación del mundo y están presentes para crear una atmósfera oscura especial que muestra hasta dónde puede llegar una persona en su búsqueda por sobrevivir.
La acción se desarrolla en la Edad Media fantástica, mazmorras del miedo y el hambre, ubicadas en el territorio del reino de Rondon, análogo de Francia y Gran Bretaña en 1590 del siglo XVI. Hay cuatro personajes para elegir: Mercenario, Caballero, Sacerdote Oscuro y Outlander. Los héroes entran en las mazmorras con un propósito: encontrar a un hombre encarcelado en ellas llamado Le'Gard. Cada personaje tiene su propio motivo para el descenso y su propia historia de fondo. En el corazón del mundo se encuentran dioses antiguos como Gro-Goroth, el dios de la destrucción y el sacrificio, y Sylvian, la diosa del amor y la creación. Son seres extremadamente poderosos que son adorados por ciertas facciones de personas. También hay nuevos dioses en el mundo, mortales que se sientan en el trono de la Ascensión en la legendaria ciudad de los dioses Ma'Havra.
El juego tiene una docena de finales posibles.

es.title: Spica Adventure [NSZ][ENG]
es.description:
¡Únete a Nico, una niña vestida toda de rosa con un extraordinario paraguas, en un peligroso y colorido viaje por el espacio!

Disfruta por primera vez en consolas modernas de este juego de plataformas y acción en 2D lleno de encanto y dibujos animados de la leyenda de los salones arcade TAITO. La sombrilla amarilla recuerda a Parasol Stars: The Story of Bubble Bobble III y se convertirá rápidamente en tu accesorio favorito y tu mejor arma. ¡Úsalo para derrotar a una salvaje mezcla de enemigos sacados de una caja de juguetes!

Ya sean combos de puñetazos, disparos, saltos desde plataformas, deslizamiento o flotación, Nico y su sombrilla disponen de un arsenal de movimientos tan variado como sus coloridos oponentes. No olvides usar la sombrilla como protección, ¡y eso no significa contra el sol! Defiende, esquiva y refleja los proyectiles enemigos en hasta 8 direcciones.

Acepta el reto de 28 niveles repartidos en varios caminos. ¡Elige un nuevo viaje por el universo de Spica cada vez que juegues de nuevo!

Contiene:
• Directamente de los salones arcade: Disfruta de un clásico de los arcades que ve la luz por primera vez en consolas. 
• Un caleidoscopio de colores: Disfruta de unos gráficos 2D únicos, simpáticos y llenos de color.
• Under My Umbrella-Ella-Ella: ¡Demuestra tus amplias habilidades de lucha con la sombrilla!
• A través del Universo: Elige tu propio viaje a través de los 28 coloridos escenarios de Spica.
• Legendaria música inspirada en los arcades: ¡Siente el ritmo de las melodías funky de ZUNTATA!

Embárcate en esta aventura para salvar a Spica de unos enemigos simpáticos pero mortales... ¡Y no te olvides de meter la sombrilla en la maleta!

es.title: emulador Sega Model 3 Arcade: Daytona USA 2, Virtua Fighter 3, Sega Super GT Scud Race Twin, Fighting Vipers 2, Emergency Call Ambulance, Spikeout, Star Wars Trilogy, Sega Rally 2 (na SuperModel NX) [NRO][ENG]
es.description:
Una máquina arcade (máquina arcade, de monedas) es un rack con equipo para ejecutar juegos, generalmente del género arcade, instalado en lugares públicos, salas de juego, etc. Muchos juegos de computadora famosos aparecieron por primera vez en las máquinas tragamonedas y solo después de un tiempo se trasladaron a consolas y computadoras domésticas.
La máquina arcade SEGA Model 3 fue desarrollada por Sega Enterprises en colaboración con Lockheed Martin y se presentó por primera vez en la exposición AOU (Amusement Machine Operators' Union) en 1996. El procesador central es un chip de arquitectura PowerPC con gráficos Real3D Pro-1000 de Mitsubishi, que en el momento de su lanzamiento era la placa base más potente existente para máquinas arcade para procesar en tiempo real el máximo número posible de polígonos texturizados utilizando las tecnologías gráficas más avanzadas en ese momento, como multimuestreo, desenfoque de movimiento, animación facial, luces y reflejos, iluminación especular, además del uso de múltiples fuentes de luz. En el año 2000, las ventas totales de sistemas arcade basados ​​en placas Model 2 y Model 3 superaron las 200.000 unidades.
Se incluyen los siguientes 8 juegos de SEGA Model 3:

es.title: Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Edition, Vol. 2 (MGS 4 Guns of the Patriots / Peace Walker / Metal Gear Ghost Babel) [NSZ][ENG]
es.developer: Konami Computer Entertainment Japan, Kojima Productions
es.description:
Metal Gear Solid es una serie de videojuegos de acción y sigilo. El productor, director, diseñador de juegos y guionista del juego, el creador de la serie es Hideo Kojima.
La colección incluye Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots y Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker (versión HD Collection), así como contenido adicional: la banda sonora digital y Metal Gear: Ghost Babel.
La tensión máxima de colarse en territorio enemigo. La serie Metal Gear es el referente del género de acción sigilosa. Sumérgete en el mundo de Metal Gear, una serie que se ha convertido en el estándar del género de acción sigilosa, en la que penetras detrás de las líneas enemigas y completas varias misiones, mientras intentas evitar encontrarte con tus enemigos. Cada juego contiene un Libro de Guiones con todo el texto del juego, así como un Libro Maestro con información detallada sobre la trama y los personajes. Como bonificación por comprar la Edición de Coleccionista, los jugadores recibirán METAL GEAR Ghost Babel, el primer juego de la serie para consolas portátiles, lanzado en 2000, y Metal Gear Solid: Digital Soundtrack Vol.2 con una variedad de pistas legendarias, desde pistas de fondo del juego hasta canciones completas con voces que añaden atmósfera a las misiones de Snake.

es.description: Nordic Ashes es un desafiante juego roguelite-survivor de inspiración nórdica en el que tendrás que sobrevivir a hordas de criaturas que se abalanzan sobre ti.

es.title: Ketsu Battler + 2 DLC [NSZ][ENG]

Ketsu Butler is a hilarious action game in which players fight by shaking their butts!

When you set the Joy-Con™ on your pants and swing it, Ketsu Batller on the screen will also swing his sword in time with your movement! Hit your opponent in the head with your sword and win the game!

Each of the six Ketsu Batller players has a different personality! Charge up your power by shaking your buttocks and overwhelm your opponent with your powerful moves!

es.title: Content Warning [NSZ][RUS/Multi13]
es.description:
¡Graba a tus amigos haciendo cosas aterradoras para hacerte viral en SpöökTube! (Recomendamos fervientemente ir en compañía).

EL PLAN ES ESTE
¡Alcanza la fama o muere en el intento! Content Warning es un juego de terror cooperativo en el que tendrás que grabar cosas que den miedo con tus amigos para intentar hacerte viral.

Paso uno: Ir al antiguo mundo
Formad un equipo, personalizad vuestro aspecto con ASCII, comprad equipamiento y utilizad la campana de buceo para ir al antiguo mundo.

Allí abajo encontraréis monstruos animados terroríficos, reliquias malditas y otros artefactos.

Paso dos: Grabar algo que dé miedo
Graba tantas cosas aterradoras como puedas antes de quedarte sin oxígeno (o sin amigos).

Paso tres: Subirlo a SpöökTube
Si sobrevives, tienes que volver a la campana de buceo para que tanto tú como el resto de tu equipo podáis volver a la superficie.

Sube las caóticas imágenes a SpöökTube, presta atención a la pantalla ¡y espera a que suban las visitas!

Por último… ¡a cobrar!
Cada ronda dura 3 días. Cuanto más contenido aterrador grabes, más viral te harás. Los ingresos por anuncios en vídeos de SpöökTube te permiten mejorar el equipamiento para grabar mejores vídeos y sobrevivir más fácilmente en el antiguo mundo.

Si tu equipo consigue suficientes visitas en tres días, podrás continuar tu carrera en SpöökTube y disfrutar de una vida de fama y fortuna.

¡También puedes aceptar patrocinios para conseguir MC y poder comprar sombreros y mejoras para la isla!

¿QUÉ PUEDE SALIR MAL?

Características del juego
Videocámara funcional dentro del juego.
Cooperativo en línea para 2-4 jugadores.
Chat de voz.
Personalización de aspecto con ASCII.
Haz grabaciones en el juego y guárdalas.
Amigos haciendo el tonto.
Monstruos animados terroríficos.
Artefactos malditos.
Linternas (muchas).
Fama (depende).

Tienda: Usa los ingresos de anuncios para comprar cosas útiles y molonas
Por cada vídeo que subas a SpöökTube, conseguirás ingresos de anuncios que podrás gastar en cosas molonas (y útiles) en la tienda, como equipamiento, gestos, utilería y equipamiento médico.
Personalizador de caras ASCII: elige tu expresión facial favorita
¡Personaliza tu cara con el teclado y el personalizador de caras ASCII del juego!
¡A divertirse!

Aleks Merser prikhodit v sebya v morge korporatsii «Gentek» bez pamyati o proshlom — i s telom, sposobnym pogloshchat lyudey, perenimat ikh oblik, vospominaniya i navyki. Poka ulitsy zakhvatyvayut zarazhyonnye, a voennye iz «Chyornogo dozora» zachishchayut gorod vmeste s zhitelyami, Aleks sobiraet po kusochkam pravdu o tom, kto on takoy i kto vypustil zarazu.
